name: 未読メッセージの境界
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE real catalog component LH03-0011「未読メッセージの境界」.
Image1 ORIGINAL has highest priority for source fine line geometry, optical weight, label alignment and meaningful unread-state accent. Image2 mock secondary only for Japanese copy, logical390x34px layout and locked typography. Image3 official white surface/restraint guidance only.
Create one extremely compact unread boundary, no card: thin1px logical horizontal divider366px long on pure white #FFFFFF canvas; exact Japanese label「ここから未読」right-aligned just above the line as in original NEW marker. MeiryoBold logical12px/16px, tracking0, one line. Keep original compact small offset above rule and restrained overall height, uniformly enlarged for sharp output.
Color decision grounded in original: source uses berry/pink NEW plus a fine related divider to denote the unread boundary, distinct from message text and primary actions. Retain that meaningful status accent coherently: label muted berry #AD3156, fine rule softened berry #C3859C. This is an unread status marker, not an error, warning or action. Do not automatically make it green or add a green button. No mint tint.
Landscape3:1 pure-white output, ONE full-width readable boundary centered with modest horizontal white margins and surrounding white space. No added icons, count, badge background, gradient, shadow, heading, message content, phone frame or duplicate variants. Preserve complete Japanese label and crisp quiet separator geometry.
reviewNotes: 原画像のNEWと関連線が担う未読状態の意味を維持し、ラベル#AD3156・細線#C3859Cへ統一。モックは日本語ここから未読と12/16Boldの副参照。実画像を目視し、全文・右寄せ・1本の細線・白背景・不要なボタン/記号なしを確認。未読計算の実装・正確な書体計測・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
